stories.given: a passage with display:none section headings
stories.then: hidden headings are not in the spoken string

stories.given: the device exposes several English voices
stories.then: the highest-scored female/warm voice is sticky for the session

stories.given: a network or neural English voice
stories.then: a single rate from policy bands is used for the whole session
a global Listen dock exists and every customer screen is a speech surface

stories.when: the quiz (or any other covering surface) becomes active, including while voices are still loading
stories.then: speech stops because the speaking root is no longer the active surface and in-flight sessions abort

stories.given: Listen is reading a passage and Chrome never fires onboundary
stories.when: the word clock advances with elapsed time and the session rate
stories.then: the highlighted word is at most one word behind the predicted spoken word
the engine waits for voices or the policy deadline, and aborts if the surface changed while waiting
it does not shrink-and-replay the same chunk

stories.when: the kid taps an advanced word
stories.then: passage speech stops and the word sheet auto-speaks without the surface-stop cancelling it

stories.given: the kid has scrolled the passage
stories.then: read-aloud starts at the top-most paragraph in the viewport, not the title if it has left the fold
dependencies initialize first and cycles throw
hasScrolledToEnd is true so Continue can start the quiz
misses are coached and there is no pass wall
the component depends on speech and exposes open/close
the word is said twice, then a simple meaning, then three daily-life examples that each contain the word
generate/share functions are registered and child data stays on-device
sections exist so the reading surface has something to show

stories.given: a passage body that repeats a vocabulary word
stories.then: only the first occurrence is a tappable mark

stories.given: a component emits pii.* or undeclared network
stories.then: the event is blocked and child data stays local

stories.given: a generated question set for a passage
stories.when: the kid thinks through the quiz
stories.then: five takeaway items reinforce the top idea and are spread through the set, with two kid word items and friend-style hints
there are three tabs: Words, Passages, and Settings

stories.given: the child leaves mid-passage, on Home, or mid-quiz
stories.when: they open WordSpark again on that device
stories.then: boot restores that surface, passage, scroll, Home tab, or quiz index

stories.given: Settings is open on a browser that may never fire beforeinstallprompt
stories.then: Install is visible with Add to Home Screen copy, and installed mode reuses the same on-device memory

stories.given: the 100 passages and 1000 words are the first learning catalogs
stories.then: both catalogs register, list, and open through the shared registry
list and catalog HTML work without a shell if on math and without mapping VOCABULARY in the shell
